description_en: Queries the list of model provider endpoints
description_zh: 查询模型提供商 Endpoint 列表
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center list-model-provider-endpoints --provider-name example-string --biz-type 1 --agent-platform example-string --agent-provider example-string --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListModelProviderEndpoints

parameters.help_en: The name of the model provider, such as bailian, moonshot, or siliconflow. If this parameter is not specified, the endpoint configurations of all managed providers are returned
parameters.help_zh: 模型提供商名称（如 bailian、moonshot、siliconflow）。不传则返回所有纳管提供商的 endpoint 配置
parameters.name: provider_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the agent platform, such as ENTERPRISE. This parameter is not currently processed and is only passed through as a redundant pass-through parameter
parameters.help_zh: Agent 平台名（暂不参与处理，仅冗余透传，如 ENTERPRISE）
parameters.name: agent_platform

parameters.help_en: The name of the agent provider, such as HermesAgent or OpenClaw. If this parameter is specified, the providerName in the returned endpoint is the alias from the perspective of the specified agent provider
parameters.help_zh: Agent Provider 名（如 HermesAgent / OpenClaw），非空时返回 endpoint 的 providerName 为该 AgentProvider 视角下的 alias
parameters.name: agent_provider
